messages:
Tom (AE): quick heads up, Bankly POC is blocked. Their client throws "SyntaxError: Unexpected token " in JSON at position 510" when using function-calling + streaming. They share assembled stream.

Priya (SE): can you paste the assembled stream and SDK version? Any 429s reported?

Tom (AE): sdk-js 0.10.1, model rdx-large-2026, streaming=true. assembled stream they captured:

```
{"role":"assistant","tool_call":{"name":"create_transfer","args":"{\"amount\":250,\"currency\":\"EUR\"}"}}}
<progress>done</progress>
```

Priya (SE): that trailing <progress> token will break a naive JSON.parse. two immediate options: (1) client sanitize the buffer (trim after matching object) or (2) toggle streaming=false for POC. Can you check ingress for 429s?

Hannah (infra): ingress shows brief burst hits from Bankly test runner. snippet:

[2026-12-02T09:21:03Z] tenant=bankly route=/v1/generate status=429 qps=150 limit=120 burst=120

Hannah (infra): 429s will cause connection resets and leave partial payloads; combined with our post-object progress tokens this can create invalid JSON. I can bump their burst by +60 for 48h to stabilize POC. Note: this will affect billing if applied long term.

Jules (eng): short-term SDK fix: add sanitizeStreamingJson option in client SDK to strip trailing non-json tokens when json_mode=STRICT and streaming=true. I'll open PR and cut a patch release. Meanwhile, recommend client apply a lightweight sanitizer: find first balanced object and JSON.parse that.

Tom (AE): customer prefers streaming UX. Please proceed with both: temporary burst increase + SDK patch. Also they asked for SOC2 and redaction info 12; I'll send security pack.

Priya (SE): plan: (1) Hannah apply +60 burst for 48h; (2) Jules open PR and publish patch v0.10.2; (3) Tom ask customer to apply client-side sanitizer until patch lands. I'll draft a short troubleshooting note for them.

Hannah (infra): applied burst=180 for tenant=bankly, TTL 48h.

Jules (eng): opened PR #611 for sanitizeStreamingJson, default true for strict json_mode. ETA release ~2.5h. Will post link and release notes. :rocket:

Tom (AE): thanks team 44d please ping when patch is out.

Triage-bot: ticket RED-5120 created (Bankly POC: streaming fncall parse failures). owners: Jules, Hannah, Priya. https://redwood.atlassian.com/RED-5120
